اقعنسسوا (form XIV)
# اِقْعَنْسَسُوا (iqʕansasū) /iq.ʕan.sa.suː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِقْعَنْسَسَ (iqʕansasa)
# اِقْعَنْسِسُوا (iqʕansisū) /iq.ʕan.si.suː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِقْعَنْسَسَ (iqʕansasa)
